questions.prompt: Chicken is ___ than beef. (A most expensive, B more expensive, C expensive, D the most expensive)
steps: Than calls for the comparative more expensive.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Is there ___ water in the tank? (A much, B any, C less, D a lot)
steps: Any asks whether water is present; much asks about quantity and less compares quantities.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: B. Any is intended; A. much and C. less are possible with different meanings.

questions.prompt: I ___ Madandari for a very long time. (A have known, B know, C knew, D has known)
steps: For a continuing period use the present perfect have known.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: This is Mussa's car. It is ___. (A his, B hers, C ours, D theirs)
steps: His is the possessive pronoun for the stated male owner.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: My sister bought a ___ of bananas. (A tray, B group, C bunch, D troop)
steps: A connected cluster of bananas is a bunch.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What opens or locks a house door? (A torch, B spoon, C key, D hammer)
steps: A key operates a lock.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Amina rides her ___ to school daily. (A bicycle, B wheelbarrow, C van, D car)
steps: Ride a bicycle is the intended means of travel.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We cook food in the ___. (A meat, B kitchen, C bathroom, D bedroom)
steps: A kitchen is used for cooking.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Which differs from table, chair, desk, chalk? (A table, B desk, C chalk, D furniture)
steps: The others are furniture; chalk is a writing material.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Who sells goods in a shop? (A buyer, B sell, C shopkeeper, D fisherman)
steps: Shopkeeper names the person running a shop.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The teacher is ___ us English now. (A teaching, B taught, C teaches, D teach)
steps: Is teaching is present continuous.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: John ___ a pen and pencil in his bag. (A was, B has, C have, D is)
steps: John takes has for possession.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We have ___ teachers. (A any, B a lot, C much, D many)
steps: Many goes with the plural count noun teachers.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The roof is ___ the classroom. (A under, B near, C over, D in)
steps: A roof covers the room from above.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We ___ to Mikumi last holiday. (A go, B went, C going, D goes)
steps: Last holiday calls for the past tense went.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: His ___ looked at the ___ (sun, son).
steps: A son is a person who looks; the sun is the object seen.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: His son looked at the sun.

questions.prompt: Throw ___ away. (eat, it)
steps: It is an object pronoun after throw.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Give us ___ sugar. (sum, some)
steps: Some expresses an unspecified quantity of sugar.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: His grandfather ___ people. (heels, heals)
steps: Heal means make well.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: He is too ___ to walk. (week, weak)
steps: Weak means lacking strength.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Pupils used ___ to sweep the classroom. Arrange mboors.
steps: All letters form brooms, tools used for sweeping.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Many ___ are made of steel. Arrange sitenlsu.
steps: The letters form utensils.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: I brush my teeth with a ___. Arrange rohbtoush.
steps: Toothbrush requires an additional t and o; it cannot be formed from rohbtoush exactly.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: Toothbrush is intended, but the printed letters are defective.

questions.prompt: Naomi ___ a chart on the wall. (notice)
steps: The story is in the past; add d to notice.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: As she ___ into her classroom. (walk)
steps: Walked gives the completed past action; was walking describes the ongoing action when she noticed the chart.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: Walked; was walking is also possible.

questions.prompt: Each box was ___ with colours. (fill)
steps: Use the past participle after was in the passive.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Mathematics was ___ by Kiswahili. (follow)
steps: Followed by means occurring next in sequence.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Where did David and his mother wait for a bus?
steps: The passage states their waiting place.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What did the nurse use to take David's temperature?
steps: The passage names the instrument.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What did the doctor use to find injured parts?
steps: The passage says the doctor used X-ray imaging.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What is the hospital place where patients are kept for rest?
steps: David was sent to ward number one.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: When patients feel better, they are ___ from hospital.
steps: The passage says David was discharged after recovering.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
